description: This file defines the TabController class for handling system and user-configurable tabs within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for retrieving, setting, and restoring system and user-specific tab configurations, managing caching, and handling module permissions.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Main class managing system and user tabs in SuiteCRM, including retrieval, caching, setting, and restoration of tab configurations.

methods.name: is_system_tabs_in_db
methods.description: Checks if system tabs are stored in the database settings.

methods.name: get_system_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves current system tab configuration, caches it, and returns it as an array.

methods.name: get_tabs_system
methods.description: Returns arrays of active and inactive system tabs, accounting for iframe module existence.

methods.name: set_system_tabs
methods.description: Saves the given tab configuration into system settings.

methods.name: get_users_can_edit
methods.description: Checks if users are permitted to edit settings based on system configuration.

methods.name: set_users_can_edit
methods.description: Sets whether non-admin users can edit settings.

methods.name: get_key_array
methods.description: Converts an array into an associative array where keys and values are identical.

methods.name: get_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves user-specific tab preferences, defaults to system tabs if not set.

methods.name: get_unset_tabs
methods.description: Returns tabs that are available but not currently assigned to the user.

methods.name: get_old_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves previous tab preferences, fallback to system tabs if none exist.

methods.name: get_old_tabs
methods.description: Returns previous and system tab configurations.

methods.name: get_tabs
methods.description: Returns display, hide, and remove tab configurations based on user permissions.

methods.name: restore_tabs
methods.description: Resets the user’s tab preferences to the default module list.

methods.name: restore_system_tabs
methods.description: Resets system tab configuration to default module list.
